# SodaPeak Product Guide

> Independent, affiliate-funded information page about SodaPeak, a chewable gummy dietary supplement marketed for male vitality. Not the manufacturer or seller. Facts checked 27 November 2026.

## Key facts
- Form: chewable gummy; label serving is 1 gummy per day.
- Each bottle holds 30 gummies, roughly a 30-day supply.
- No allergen statement on the label; 5 mg caffeine and 3 g added sugar per gummy.
- No clinical trial of the finished product was found.
- Label reads "Assembled in the USA" while the sales page claims US manufacture with globally sourced ingredients.
- Listed ingredients: Muira Puama Extract; Maca Extract; Catuaba Extract; Green Tea Extract; Caffeine 5 mg; Ashwagandha; L-Arginine; Tribulus Terrestris; Horny Goat Weed Extract
- Package prices shown: 2 Bottles $79/bottle ($9.99 Shipping), 3 Bottles $69/bottle (FREE Shipping), 6 Bottles $49/bottle (FREE Shipping)
- Seller guarantee: 60 days (seller terms apply)
- Retailer: BuyGoods
